children: Edarat Communication and Information Technology Company (EDARAT) said it has secured a contract from Almoammar Information Systems Company (MIS) to build an artificial intelligence (AI) data centre in Saudi Arabia.

The scope of work includes design, supervision, testing and commissioning services for the data centre, which will have an aggregate planned capacity of 200 megawatts (MW), the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
The contract is valued at 197.8 million ($52.67 million), the statement added.
In April, Edarat signed a framework agreement with Saudi Energy (SE) to provide design, construction supervision, testing, and commissioning services for data centre projects.
